name: Quinton Rolle Jr.
strengths: Rolle uses 6-0 length to stay stacked on the perimeter and disrupt releases at Miami Central.
Rolle shows patience in man coverage and does not panic when receivers stem at him.
Rolle closes to the football and contests with long arms at the catch point.
weaknesses: Rolle still needs to add significant mass to his 160-pound frame for SEC outside durability.
comparison: Rolle comps to Derek Stingley Jr. — 6-0 length corner who stacks receivers, stays patient in phase, and contests with arm length.
projection: Rolle projects as a Year 2–3 SEC starter at CB (special teams / nickel Year 1). Ceiling: every-down SEC press corner — the Miami Central length CB who can lock the boundary once strength catches the frame.
schemeFit: Rolle fits White’s press/man boundary CB who wins with length and patience before the frame fills.
insiderNotes: Rolle is a lean 6-0 Miami Central corner who wins with length, patience in man, and catch-point contests. Frame still needs mass at 160. Wins with phase discipline — a South Florida CB Florida has to stay on.

recruitingStory: Quinton Rolle Jr. is a 4 CB · listed 6-0 / 160 · Miami Central (Miami, FL) · open-board Florida target.
angle: Lead with Miami Central length + phase patience; Florida in-state CB chase.
